subject: Stalfos
text: In the Forest Temple, if one Stalfos in the pair is defeated and the second is not defeated quickly, the first one will re-assemble.

evidence.quote: The thing here is, these two depend on each other. If you kill one, if you don't kill the other quickly, the first one will re-assemble, so be quick with these guys.

subject: large treasure chest
text: Defeating the pair of Stalfos makes a large treasure chest appear containing the FAIRY BOW.

evidence.quote: Killing them will finally make a large treasure chest appear. Open it to get the FAIRY BOW, which is a very useful projectile attack for Adult Link.

subject: Poe sister
text: Staying at a distance to keep the Poe picture visible and shooting all three pictures with arrows causes the Poe sister to appear at the bottom.

evidence.quote: What you have to do is be at a certain distance to keep the picture there, and fire an arrow with your new Bow at the picture. Do this with all three pictures and the Poe sister from the pictures will appear and will wait at the bottom.

subject: small chest
text: Defeating the first Poe sister causes a small chest containing a SMALL KEY to appear.

evidence.quote: A small chest will appear, and you'll get a SMALL KEY.

subject: large chest
text: Defeating the Poe sister in the second staircase room reveals a large chest containing the COMPASS.

evidence.quote: Here's another staircase room with three pictures of a Poe sister. Get rid of them all, then get rid of the actual Poe the same way you did the first one, and a large chest will appear. Open it for the COMPASS for this dungeon.

subject: silver eye switch
text: Shooting an arrow at the silver eye switch untwists the hallway.

evidence.quote: Now get back past the twisted hall, then turn around and fire an arrow at the silver eye switch. This will untwist the hallway.

subject: small chest
text: Hitting the gold eye switch with an arrow makes a small chest containing a bundle of Arrows appear.

evidence.quote: Now, in this huge room, you might have seen a gold eye switch. If you hit it with an arrow, a small chest containing a bundle of Arrows.

subject: colorful chest
text: Falling down after passing the untwisted hallway leads to a colorful chest containing the BOSS KEY.

evidence.quote: Go back through the now-untwisted hallway, then fall down and open the colorful chest for the BOSS KEY, which lets you access the door leading to the boss room.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Looking up at the end of the thin walkway with Recovery Hearts allows Link to Hookshot a Gold Skulltula (058 out of 100).

evidence.quote: Get to the end, look up, and Hookshot the Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 058 out of 100).

subject: treasure chest
text: Fully defeating the Floormaster causes a treasure chest containing a SMALL KEY to appear.

evidence.quote: If you get rid of the Floormaster fully, a treasure chest will appear. Open it to get a SMALL KEY, then head through the other door outside this room.

subject: Green Bubbles
text: Green Bubbles are killed by slashing them when their fires subside.

evidence.quote: There's Green Bubbles here. In order to kill these, slash them when their fires subside.

subject: eyeball switch
text: Firing an arrow across a torch on the rotating platform lights the arrow in flames, melting the ice and triggering the eyeball switch.

evidence.quote: In here, you have to hit an eyeball switch with an arrow, but it's covered in ice, and there's a torch in the middle of rotating platforms. Get on one of the platforms, aim at the switch, and fire an arrow when you pass the torch. This will light the arrow on flames and will melt the ice AND hit the switch.

subject: treasure chest
text: In the falling ceiling room of the Forest Temple, a treasure chest contains a bundle of arrows.

evidence.quote: Hit the switch when you can to unlock the door ahead, and continue to the treasure chest. Open it to get a bundle of arrows, then head through the door to reach a room.

subject: colored blocks
text: Assembling the tops of the colored blocks to match the picture causes the Poe sister to emerge.

evidence.quote: What you have to do here is assemble the blocks by pushing them. You have to assemble the top side of the blocks so that they match the picture.

subject: last Poe sister
text: The real fourth Poe sister can be distinguished from her copies because she spins around when appearing.

evidence.quote: The same Poe will make copies of herself and surround you. They look virtually the same but the one way to tell the difference is that the real one spins around when she and her copies appear.

subject: outward walls
text: Pushing the outward walls in Basement 2 rotates the entire room to allow tripping three switches.

evidence.quote: You have to trip three switches, and in order to do so, you have to push the outward walls, which rotates the WHOLE room.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula (059 out of 100) is hidden in the treasure chest section of Basement 2.

evidence.quote: Also there's a Gold Skulltula hidden here. Make sure to get it before leaving this room. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 059 out of 100) It's in the treasure chest section of the room.

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: When Phantom Ganon emerges from a painting surrounded by purple magic, Link must shoot an arrow at the real phantom, as failing to do so triggers a lightning attack that inflicts at least five hearts of damage.

evidence.quote: Basically what you have to do, is aim your arrow at the Phantom when he escapes from the painting. (purple magic surrounds him when he's about to exit) The thing is, there's TWO of these phantoms. The fake one turns around, so if you encounter that one, hurry up and find the real one and fire that arrow. If you don't, you'll be struck with a lightning attack that takes away at least five hearts.

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: Swinging the Master Sword to reflect Phantom Ganon's magic spell back and forth stuns him when it connects, leaving him vulnerable to sword slashes on the floor.

evidence.quote: Use the Master Sword and swing it at the right time to reflect the magic spell back at Phantom Ganon. He'll usually reflect it back, so continue this tennis game until it hits either one of you. If it hits Phantom Ganon he'll go to the floor, stunned. So go up to him and slash him.

subject: Phantom Ganon
text: Standing very close to Phantom Ganon after his stallion disappears allows Link to deflect the magic ball attack immediately without giving him time to react.

evidence.quote: SPEEDY STRATEGY: After getting rid of its stallion, get really close to Phantom Ganon, and time your slash right so that it's deflected as soon as it fires its magic ball attack. Doing this won't give it enough time to react, and will immediately get hit.

subject: HEART CONTAINER
text: Defeating Phantom Ganon causes a HEART CONTAINER and a warp light to appear.

evidence.quote: When it is dead, a HEART CONTAINER (pick it up) and a light will appear.

subject: Saria
text: In the Chamber of Sages, Saria reveals herself as the Sage of the Forest Temple and gives Link the Forest Medallion.

evidence.quote: After grabbing the Container, step into the light and you'll be at the Chamber of Sages again. Saria will appear, tell you that she's the Sage of the Forest Temple, and give you the Forest Medallion.

subject: PRELUDE OF LIGHT
text: Sheik teaches Link the PRELUDE OF LIGHT, an ocarina song that warps him to the Temple of Time.

evidence.quote: Also with this info, he'll teach you the PRELUDE OF LIGHT, a song which warps you to the Temple of Time.

subject: Master Sword
text: Placing the Master Sword back into its pedestal returns Link to the past as Young Link.

evidence.quote: He'll tell you that whenever you want to return to the past, simply place the Master Sword back on its pedestal.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Playing the Song of Storms near the tree at Castle Grounds reveals a hole where blowing open walls yields a Gold Skulltula (060 out of 100) collectible via Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Surface, then play the Song of Storms near the tree to open a hole. Drop in. Inside, blow open the walls until you find a Gold Skulltula. Remember that you can't use the Hookshot as Young Link, so use your Bommerang. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 060 out of 100)

subject: windmill
text: Playing the Song of Storms inside the windmill drives the mechanism out of control and drains the well.

evidence.quote: Once inside, play the Song of Storms to make the windmill mechanism go out of control, and thus draining the well.

subject: skeleton wall
text: In the Bottom of the Well, Link can walk straight through the fake wall where the skeleton is positioned.

evidence.quote: Navi will tell you that spirits are whispering a message that you must find the eye of truth. Well, this seems to be a dead-end. Wrong. Head right through the wall where the skeleton is to walk through it.

subject: large chest
text: Hugging the right wall past the water fork in the Bottom of the Well leads through a fake wall to a large chest containing the COMPASS.

evidence.quote: Turn the corner, and hug the right wall while going forward and you'll go through another fake section of wall. Open the large chest there to get the COMPASS.

subject: large treasure chest
text: Bombing the boulders past the hall with lit torches in the Bottom of the Well reveals a large treasure chest containing the DUNGEON MAP.

evidence.quote: Bomb the boulders past the hall showcased with lit torches. Kill the Redead walking around here, and open the large treasure chest to get the DUNGEON MAP.
